lesson: decodeURIComponent throws URIError on malformed input such as a lone '%'. Wrap every decode of untrusted input (path, query, header, name) in try/catch and answer 400. URLSearchParams and parsed query values are already decoded; decoding them again crashes on '%'.
source: verify-2026-10-06 P0-1, P0-2 (GET /% and a name with % crashed the server)

lesson: A simulator that picks the best move every turn is not evidence of difficulty or balance. Probe default play: a new user pressing the default option with no special knowledge, over several fresh runs, and report the loss rate.
source: verify-2026-10-06 item 8 (88% sim pass; 12 of 16 real first fights lost)

lesson: A screenshot proves only the screen it shows. To claim a fix in a scene (battle, menu, dialog, error state), drive the app into that scene first and look at that shot. A title screen or first frame does not show an in-scene fix.
source: verify-2026-10-06 item 5 (HUD drawn over battle; only field and title shots were checked)

lesson: Never kill the user-facing server or free its port for a probe. Start a probe server on another port, from a copy or with its own save file, and stop only the PID you started.
source: journal 2026-10-06 (pkill -f server/entry.js left the live game down)

lesson: A state flag set during an action must be cleared when that action or turn ends, on every exit path (success, failure, cancel). Grep each place it is set, confirm the clear, and probe two actions in a row to see the second is unaffected.
source: verify-2026-10-06 P1-5 (b.consumed never cleared; each later attack cost a lantern)

lesson: Track new log or message entries by a sequence id or timestamp, not by array length. A sender that keeps only the last N entries holds the length constant, so new entries are never seen. Probe with more than N entries.
source: verify-2026-10-06 P0-3 (dialogue stopped opening after 8 log lines)

lesson: In a close or disconnect handler, act only if this socket is still the user's current connection. A client can reconnect before the old close fires; probe a reconnect that lands before the old socket's close.
source: verify-2026-10-06 P1-4 (stale-socket race made the player vanish)

lesson: Probe after long or repeated use, not only on fresh state: repeat the action past any buffer or window size, reload mid-flow, and use the default inputs a new user would. Many bugs appear only once a log, cache or list is full.
source: verify-2026-10-06 item 4 (dialogue tested once on a fresh log)

lesson: Layers drawn every frame must be gated by scene: hide field overlays in battle, menus and dialogs. Check each scene for overlap with a screenshot of that scene, at each target screen size.
source: verify-2026-10-06 P1-6 (overworld HUD covered the battle menu)

lesson: A cap or clamp can be a no-op: if the cap is above the band's maximum, it never applies. Print the values the rule actually produced for the target case before claiming it works.
source: verify-2026-10-06 item 8 (level cap 5 above the Flats band max 4)

lesson: Do not detect a process by matching its command text (pgrep -f, ps | grep): the match also finds your own shell or the script that launched it. Use the PID you started, a pidfile, or a health request.
source: journal 2026-10-05 (pgrep -f matched its own command line; the shim never started)

lesson: node --check, tsc and lint prove syntax only. Before marking an item done, run something that executes the changed path: a test, a request, or a scripted use of the feature, and read its output.
source: session 2026-10-06 (goal completed after node --check and a simulator only)

lesson: Prefer a data-level check (import the module and assert the values) over steering a bot through the UI to reach one state. Throwaway walker scripts cost hours; stop after one attempt and check the data instead.
source: journal 2026-10-05 (two hours on six walker scripts while content stayed uncommitted)

lesson: Static files: decode once, normalise and resolve the path, then check it against the allowed roots. Test with curl --path-as-is for ../, %2e%2e, %252e, ..%2f and a lone %; each must give 404 or 400 and the server must stay up.
source: verify-2026-10-06 item 1 and morning review (whitelist checked before .. was normalised)
